item.title: War Department to partner with OpenAI to integrate ChatGPT into GenAI.mil
item.description: The War Department is partnering with OpenAI to integrate ChatGPT into a military platform, making advanced models available to 3 million personnel.

item.title: Mortgage affordability hits four-year high as White House points to Trump housing policies
item.description: Mortgage affordability is at a four-year high after rates fell in January, with the White House touting President Donald Trump’s economic policies and maintaining his promise to “unlock" the opportunity of homeownership for American families.

item.title: High schools rethink how teens learn money skills
item.description: Students learn to prepare taxes, open Roth IRAs and manage investments in innovative personal finance classes spreading across American high schools.

item.title: Eddie Bauer retail operator files for bankruptcy, begins liquidation sales
item.description: The 106-year-old brand founded in Seattle, Washington, will begin liquidation sales while seeking buyer for brick-and-mortar operations.

item.title: Amazon Prime Air drone crashes into Texas apartment building
item.description: Amazon issued an apology after a Prime Air delivery drone crashed into an apartment building in Richardson, Texas, with the incident caught on video by a resident.

item.title: Meta researcher warned of 500K child exploitation cases daily on Facebook and Instagram platforms
item.description: Meta researcher warned company executives of 500,000 daily child sexual exploitation cases on Facebook and Instagram platforms, according to court documents.

item.title: Netflix exec calls DOJ probe into $82.7B Warner Bros deal 'ordinary course of business'
item.description: Netflix faces DOJ investigation over its proposed $82.7 billion Warner Bros acquisition, but the streaming giant calls it "ordinary course of business."

item.title: Small plane crashes into several cars during emergency landing, multiple injured
item.description: Small plane reportedly strikes three vehicles during an emergency landing on a Georgia roadway after engine failure, sending two people to a hospital with injuries.

item.title: Ford worker who heckled Trump was not disciplined and kept his job, UAW says
item.description: The Ford worker who called President Donald Trump a "pedophile protector" at a Michigan plant was not disciplined and still has his job, according to his union.

item.title: Chipotle CEO allegedly suggests company would keep raising prices and 'lean into' customers making over $100K
item.description: Chipotle CEO allegedly suggested targeting customers earning over $100,000 per year in leaked audio, sparking controversy over potential price hikes.
